info.title: Web IQ
info.description: Microsoft Web IQ is a suite of AI-native APIs that gives applications access to fresh, real-world intelligence from across the web, including search results, web pages, news, images, and videos.

post.summary: Browse and extract content from a web page
post.description: Fetches and extracts content from a specified URL. Supports live crawling, dynamic page rendering, and multiple output formats.

post.summary: Search the web for relevant content
post.description: Performs a web search and returns structured results with content from matching web pages.

url.description: The URL of the web page to browse.

maxLength.description: The maximum number of characters in the content field in response. Default value is 10000 characters, and maximum value is 500000 characters.

includeWebLinks.description: Include outbound hyperlinks from the page. Default is false.

renderDynamicPages.description: Enable JavaScript rendering for dynamic content screenshot. Only works when liveCrawl is set to 'fallback' or 'force'. Default is false.

includeImageLinks.description: Include image URLs from the page. Default is false.

language.description: The language code (2-letter ISO 639-1). Default is 'en'.

region.description: The region code (2-letter country/region code). Default is 'US'.

url.description: The URL of the web page.

title.description: The title of the web page.

content.description: The extracted content of the web page.

isAdult.description: Indicates if the content is adult content.

lastUpdatedAt.description: The last updated date of the webpage, follows ISO8601 format.

crawledAt.description: The last crawled date of the webpage, follows ISO8601 format.

retryAfter.description: Retry after value when on-demand crawl is in progress. Only present when the page needs to be crawled.

traceId.description: Trace ID for debugging and tracking.

liveCrawlSucceeded.description: Only present as false when an auto or force live-crawl response returns a stale page. Omitted otherwise.

url.description: The source URL of the image. For China users with URL redirection enabled, this field instead contains the same redirect URL as clickUrl.

domain.description: The destination host for the result. Returned only for China users with URL redirection enabled.

hostPageUrl.description: The host page URL of the image.

width.description: The width of the image, in pixels.

height.description: The height of the image, in pixels.

thumbnailUrl.description: The thumbnail source URL of the image.

lastUpdatedAt.description: The last updated date of the image, follows ISO8601 format.

isAdult.description: Indicates whether the content is adult content.

clickUrl.description: Redirect URL that proxies through Bing. Only present when redirect is enabled.

instrumentationSuffix.description: Suffix to append to the instrumentation ping URL base for this result item.

maxResults.description: Max number of results to return. Default is 30 and maximum value is 30.

language.description: A 2-letter ISO 639-1 language code for interface language in the search results. Default: 'en'.

region.description: A 2-letter country/region code for where the results should come from (e.g. 'US', 'JP', 'CN'). Default is 'US'.

watermarkFree.description: Exclude images with watermark. Default is false.

maxHeight.description: Maximum image height in pixels. Used with imageSize for custom bounds.

instrumentationClickBase.description: Base URL for click ping requests. Append an instrumentationSuffix value from a result item to form the full ping URL.

instrumentationCitationBase.description: Base URL for LLM log ping requests. Append a DATA payload to form the full ping URL.

traceId.description: Trace ID for debugging and tracking.

url.description: The source URL of the news article. For China users with URL redirection enabled, this field instead contains the same redirect URL as clickUrl.

domain.description: The destination host for the result. Returned only for China users with URL redirection enabled.

content.description: The detailed content of the news.

lastUpdatedAt.description: The last updated date of the news, in UTC ISO8601 format.

crawledAt.description: The last crawled date of the news, follows ISO8601 format.

language.description: The language of the news article, uses ISO 639-1 language code.

source.description: Publisher name, such as 'USA TODAY | MSN', 'CNN', etc.

isAdult.description: Indicates if the content is adult content.

clickUrl.description: Redirect URL that proxies through Bing. Only present when redirect is enabled.

instrumentationSuffix.description: Suffix to append to the instrumentation ping URL base for this result item.

query.description: A search query for the news.

maxResults.description: Max number of results to return. Default is 10 and maximum value is 20.

language.description: A 2-letter ISO 639-1 language code for interface language in the search results. Default: 'en'.

region.description: A 2-letter country/region code for where the results should come from (e.g. 'US', 'JP', 'CN'). Default is 'US'.

location.description: Location information in format 'lat:<float>;long:<float>', e.g. 'lat:40.753250;long:-74.003807'. If not specified, could infer location in query.

maxLength.description: The maximum number of characters in the content field in response. Default value is 10000 characters, and maximum value is 500000 characters.

instrumentationClickBase.description: Base URL for click ping requests. Append an instrumentationSuffix value from a result item to form the full ping URL.

instrumentationCitationBase.description: Base URL for LLM log ping requests. Append a DATA payload to form the full ping URL.

traceId.description: Trace ID for debugging and tracking.

width.description: Width of the thumbnail, in pixels.

height.description: Height of the thumbnail, in pixels.

videos.description: Array of videos in the playlist.

title.description: The title or name of the video.

url.description: The source URL of the video. For China users with URL redirection enabled, this field instead contains the same redirect URL as clickUrl.

domain.description: The destination host for the result. Returned only for China users with URL redirection enabled.

description.description: Description of the video content. This is either given by video uploader or generated by LLM

publishedBy.description: Uploader or publisher of the video.

viewCount.description: The number of views the video has.

summary.description: Short summary or highlight of the video.

length.description: The length of the video in HH:MM:SS format.

lastUpdatedAt.description: The last updated date as a formatted string.

bestMomentIndex.description: Index of the best moment or highlight in the video.

width.description: The width of the video in pixels.

height.description: The height of the video in pixels.

isAdult.description: Indicates whether the result includes adult content.

clickUrl.description: Redirect URL that proxies through Bing. Only present when redirect is enabled.

instrumentationSuffix.description: Suffix to append to the instrumentation ping URL base for this result item.

description.description: Description of what happens in this moment.

startTime.description: Start time of the moment in format 'd.hh:mm:ss'.

endTime.description: End time of the moment in format 'd.hh:mm:ss'.

momentUrl.description: Direct URL to this specific moment in the video.

maxResults.description: Max number of results to return. Default is 30 and maximum value is 30.

language.description: A 2-letter ISO 639-1 language code for interface language in the search results. Default: 'en'.

region.description: A 2-letter country/region code for where the results should come from (e.g. 'US', 'JP', 'CN'). Default is 'US'.

enablePlaylist.description: Whether to include playlist results in response. Default is false.

freshness.description: The time range to filter results based on discovery date. Supports 'week', 'month', 'year' for relative time, or ISO 8601 date interval format: 'YYYY-MM-DD/YYYY-MM-DD' or 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ/YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ' for a date/datetime range, use .. to omit start or end date.

embeddable.description: Filter videos by embedding capabilities. Allowed values: 'player' (has embeddable player). When not set, no filtering is applied.

instrumentationCitationBase.description: Base URL for LLM log ping requests. Append a DATA payload to form the full ping URL.

traceId.description: Trace ID for debugging and tracking.

query.description: A search query string. Supports 'site:' and '-site:' operators to include or exclude results from specific sites (e.g. 'query site:example.com'). Use these operators only when necessary, as they inherently reduce result relevance.

maxResults.description: Max number of results to return. Default is 10 and maximum value is 50.

language.description: A 2-letter ISO 639-1 language code for interface language in the search results. Default: 'en'.

region.description: A 2-letter country/region code for where the results should come from (e.g. 'US', 'JP', 'CN'). Default is 'US'.

maxLength.description: The maximum number of characters in the content or passage field in response. Default value is 10000 characters, and maximum value is 500000 characters.

instrumentationCitationBase.description: Base URL for LLM log ping requests. Append a DATA payload to form the full ping URL.

url.description: The source URL of the webpage. For China users with URL redirection enabled, this field instead contains the same redirect URL as clickUrl.

domain.description: The destination host for the result. Returned only for China users with URL redirection enabled.

content.description: The detailed content of the webpage.

lastUpdatedAt.description: The last updated date of the webpage, follows ISO8601 format.

crawledAt.description: The last crawled date of the webpage, follows ISO8601 format.

language.description: The language of the webpage, uses ISO 639-1 language code.

isAdult.description: Indicates whether the result includes adult content.

clickUrl.description: Redirect URL that proxies through Bing. Only present when redirect is enabled.

instrumentationSuffix.description: Suffix to append to the instrumentation ping URL base for this result item.

freshness.description: Indicates whether fresh documents should be prioritized over other documents for this query.

isAdult.description: Whether the citation contains adult content.

windMaxDirection.description: Direction of the maximum forecast wind.

validTime.description: Time period for which the averages are valid.

recordHighDate.description: Date of the record high temperature.

recordLowDate.description: Date of the record low temperature.

traceId.description: Trace ID for debugging and tracking.

results.description: Evidence results with citations scoped to each result.

query.description: A search query string. Supports 'site:' and '-site:' operators; use these operators sparingly because scoping can reduce relevance.

language.description: A two-letter ISO 639-1 interface language. Default is 'en'.

region.description: A two-letter market or country/region code. Default is 'US'.

maxResponseLength.description: Maximum total response length in characters. Default is 100000.

includeDomains.description: Restricts eligible web and news results to the listed domains. Keep the list short for best relevance.

excludeDomains.description: Omits results from the listed domains. Exclusions take precedence over inclusions when the same domain appears in both lists.

location.description: Location information in format 'lat:<float>;long:<float>'. If omitted, location information in the query is used.

responseFilter.description: List of answer types eligible for inclusion in the response. Supported values: web, news, timezone, weather, images, videos.

timeZoneName.description: Full name of the time zone.

timeZoneAbbreviation.description: Short abbreviation, e.g. KST, IST, PDT.

utcOffset.description: UTC offset in hours. Null when the source does not provide an offset.

utcTime.description: UTC time as a formatted string.

localTime.description: Local time as a formatted string.

description.description: Short human-readable summary of the answer. Empty for the date-only variant.

timeZones.description: Time zone objects for single or multi-time-zone answers.

timeDifference.description: Human-readable time difference sentence for comparison answers.

location.description: Human-readable name of the queried location.

url.description: Canonical MSN Weather attribution URL for the answer.

alerts.description: Active weather alerts. Empty when no alerts are available.

forecastedWeather.description: Daily forecasts for the configured forecast horizon.
